info.title: File4Base API Engine
info.description: Enterprise-grade REST and Dynamic Relational DDL Database Engine for File4Base. Supports runtime schema migrations, table occurrences, relationships graph, dynamic Find Mode formula parsing, security ACL, and solution archiving. Every endpoint except the health probes, sign-in and the database selector requires a session token: sign in with POST /api/v1/auth/login and send the returned token as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. A session is bound to the database it signed in to.

get.description: Returns full health diagnostic including database connectivity, uptime, version, and component status.

post.description: Creates a new physical table in PostgreSQL/MariaDB and registers it in `sys_tables` with an automatic primary key.
Executes dynamic DDL `ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN` and registers field options in `sys_columns`.

put.description: Updates display name and field options (auto-enter rules, default values, calculation formulas, validation rules).

delete.description: Drops the column from the physical database table and removes it from `sys_columns`. Cannot delete primary key.

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details for HTTP APIs

user.description: Username of the first owner account

password.description: Password of the first owner account

active.description: Database of the caller's session; empty when signed out

bearerAuth.description: Opaque session token returned by POST /api/v1/auth/login. Bound to one user and one database; expires after a period of inactivity (SESSION_TTL, default 12h).

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid or expired session token

Forbidden.description: The session's role or layout permissions do not allow this operation
